name: Sinh Le Dinh
headline: Data Plumber
summary: I am a data engineer who likes owning the whole path from raw data to something people actually trust and use. For the past few years I have been building a healthcare analytics platform on Azure, with Databricks, Delta Lake and dbt at the core and Azure DevOps for CI/CD. Day to day that means designing incremental pipelines and writing models that are tested and documented. I work closely with PMs and tech leads to turn loose requirements into maintainable models. I would rather ship one well-tested model than three clever ones. Open to Data Engineer and Analytics Engineer roles where the modern data stack and governance both matter.
